title: Classify: see the CSS classes on the page

message.text:
Classify is built (uncommitted, main tree): [/framework/ext/Classify/](/framework/ext/Classify/) — [Classify.js](/framework/ext/Classify/Classify.js).
- [x] classify(el) outlines the element + its columns, labels algorithm + classes, absolute overlay, follows resize
- [x] site-wide toggle: Alt+L (or ?classify), remembered in localStorage. No dev-bar switch yet.
- [x] page with 4 outline styles side by side (dashed items / solid container / tint / dotted)
- [x] proof on /framework/core/Page/: label "wide grid three gap" over the three-column top — shot: ai/2026/09/25/classify-see-the-css-classes-on-the-page/page-1920.png
Left: dev-bar button; picking a style is not persisted per page; no Next/Next walkthrough (the page is the demo). Overlay CSS is its own file, prefix classify-; one import line added to app.js.
